final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias reference (IREF = 10uA into ibias)
MB  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4   L=1
* tail current source (7uA)
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=2.8 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinn on diode side, vinp on output side)
M1  na vinn tail vss nfet W=2 L=0.15
M2  nb vinp tail vss nfet W=2 L=0.15
* PMOS mirror load
M3  na na vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=0.3
M4  nb na vdd vdd pfet W=2 L=0.3
* second stage: PMOS CS + NMOS sink (4uA)
M5  n2 nb    vdd vdd pfet W=2.3 L=0.3
M6  n2 ibias vss vss nfet W=1.6 L=1
* inverter 1 (small)
M7  n3 n2 vss vss nfet W=0.42 L=0.15
M8  n3 n2 vdd vdd pfet W=0.84 L=0.15
* inverter 2 (output driver, 50fF load)
M9  vout n3 vss vss nfet W=1.5 L=0.15
M10 vout n3 vdd vdd pfet W=3   L=0.15
.ends
